title: ZTIE preprocessor classification-result data contract (v1)
description: The derived classification LABEL produced by the Story 1.2 preprocessor for one intake artifact, and the shape allowed to cross the Forensic -> Hub boundary as a classification update (RD-013). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length-bounded. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256 so a label can only attach to the exact artifact it was computed over. DERIVED-ONLY: no raw body / base64 / executable content. ZERO-TRUST: a classification is a LABEL, never a safety verdict and never a forward decision - there is no verdict/safe/route field; the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4) and routing is Story 1.3. DISTRUST-THE-CLAIM: records BOTH the extension signal and the content signal, whether they agree, and which signal the final label is based on; on disagreement the content signal wins.

contract_version.description: Classification-contract schema version. Pinned so the Hub validator rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this classification is for. The Hub upserts the label onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body the label was computed over. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub must reject a label whose sha256 does not match the tracked record.

classified_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) when classification was performed in Forensic.

classification.description: The derived label and the evidence behind it. A LABEL only - never a verdict or a forward decision.

artifact_class.description: The final assigned class. On a claim/content mismatch this equals the content signal (distrust-the-claim).

basis.description: Which signal the final class is based on. 'content' when content and extension disagree (or extension is absent); 'extension' only when content is inconclusive but the extension is recognised; 'agreement' when both agree.

confidence.description: Coarse confidence in the assigned class. 'high' when a strong content structure matched; 'medium' on agreement or a single strong signal; 'low' for other_unknown / weak evidence.

signals_agree.description: True iff the extension signal and the content signal resolved to the same artifact_class. False (with the two signals recorded) is the distrust-the-claim evidence.

extension_signal.description: What the (untrusted) filename extension alone suggested. Recorded for audit even when overridden by content.

extension.description: The lowercased extension observed (without dot), or absent if the filename had none.

content_signal.description: What structural inspection of the actual bytes suggested. Authoritative on disagreement with the extension.

matched_indicator.description: Short, non-executable label of the structural cue that matched (e.g. 'cfn:AWSTemplateFormatVersion', 'shebang:sh', 'terraform:resource-block'). Audit only; never the raw content.

notes.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable diagnostic note (e.g. why the class is other_unknown). Never raw content.
